title: PhD in Information Systems and Artificial Intelligence
institution: Erasmus University Rotterdam, Rotterdam School of Management (RSM)
about: 1 FTE PhD position at Rotterdam School of Management in information systems and artificial intelligence, for candidates with quantitative skills and programming experience such as Python, interested in an academic career. Published 2 November 2026.
requirements: Background in information systems, another business school area, or a related field such as economics, computer science, econometrics or statistics
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: "Quantitative skills" → "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"

"Information systems and artificial intelligence" (field) / "computer science, econometrics or statistics" → "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
